title: AEC-000051 Verifiable Conversation Continuity
purpose: Guarantee repository-derived project resumption before replacing the primary AIAS conversation.
scope: Constitutional rule, ACE regeneration, mandatory evidence set, checksum-protected archive, tamper detection, CLI, policy and executive order.

requirements.title: Constitutional mandate
requirements.statement: AEC-000051 shall require a validated continuity package before primary-conversation migration or replacement.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Minimum evidence
requirements.statement: The package shall contain master context, project state, next task, continuation prompt and executive orders.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Integrity
requirements.statement: Every content file and the archive shall have SHA-256 verification evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Repository authority
requirements.statement: The handoff shall derive from validated ACE state rather than screenshots or narrative memory alone.
requirements.rationale: Prevent continuity loss after context compaction.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Operational CLI
requirements.statement: Operators shall be able to create and independently verify the handoff package through ACE CLI commands.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Reproducible delivery
requirements.statement: The rule shall include tests, policy, installer, checksums and release.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
